Footer with 4 groups and expandable 3-column site overview tested across 5 responsive breakpoints (320/390/820/1280/1920) with no horizontal overflow. TrioScene controls tested for hover states, no lime-on-lime issues found, no icon shift detected. DE copy uses 'Projektassistent' and 'Projektplanung' terminology correctly with consistent 'Du' form. Two minor touch target issues found (FE04). Chat collapse reading anchor (FE10) stays perfectly within 40px. Mobile composer (FE05) has sufficient height and is reachable.
